claims.text: Zettler sent Hiram Bollingsworth to the next world but not thoroughly enough: Hiram’s ghost lingered, learned to slip back into the Skinlands and became one of the Risen.
Hiram still drives toward Endron’s success in bloody and emphatic ways, and wants revenge on those who ended that life.
Magadon’s Sales and Marketing division handles all its advertising and is the part of the company the public mostly meets.
Media Crisis Teams on round-the-clock call can issue a press release within an hour of any bad story about a Magadon product anywhere in the world.
One team works only to blunt bad press for Magadon’s rivals, presented as serving the industry, which has led to research sharing with its major competitors.
Its Gerontology division reaches the public mostly through Pentex-linked nursing homes that double as testing centres.
Building on its binary chemical and biological products, Magadon has begun experimenting with binary Bane infestations, still rare because of the effort involved.
In the first stage a dormant Bane is bound into a package of pills or a bottle of serum by Black Spiral Theurges or human specialists at a Magadon factory.
The medicine ships to pharmacies and hospitals like any other, and the patient who takes it receives a sleeping Wyrm-spirit as a passenger.

title: King Breweries’ pollution
summary: The hidden truth behind King’s clean-water image.

claims.text: King Breweries’ professed concern for clean water is close to nil, and the company adds to the very problem it campaigns against.
Most breweries purify their waste before dumping it, but King does not; run-off from its main plant poisons everything up to sixty miles downstream.
A brown film covers the water and things no one can identify churn below, toxic and long-lived.
Black Dog Game Factory of Atlanta is a role-playing game publisher owned within Pentex.
When a teenager in Arizona murders two grandparents in a supposed vampire ritual, the firm’s marketing coordinator meets the outcry with open contempt for parents.
